description: Maintaining the Integrity of our Elections This week, I voted in favor of legislation (H.3444) regarding our state’s election laws. This legislation has two goals: one, to maintain the integrity of each and every vote cast, and two, to ensure elections are run consistently across the state. title: Legislative Update: Week 9, 2021 - Tommy Pope Speaker Pro Tempore for South Carolina House 47
